title: C# & .NET Essentials
description: Build modern .NET applications, ASP.NET Core APIs, and Unity games with C# 12. Master types, pattern matching, properties, records, LINQ, and async/await.
outcomes: Write concise modern C# with string interpolation, var, and nullable reference types
Simplify branching using switch expressions and relational pattern matching
Model domain objects cleanly with auto-properties, init-only setters, and records
Query and transform collections expressively using LINQ (Where, Select, OrderBy)
Write non-blocking I/O code using async, await, and Task<T>
